description: GERMANY. Computes real estate transfer tax (Grunderwerbsteuer) at the rate of each of the 16 states, notary and land registry fees from the GNotKG fee table (in force 1 June 2025), and optionally the land charge for a loan and an agent commission the user gives.

agent_commission_pct.description: Agent commission the buyer pays, % of the price (optional; no legal rate exists).

loan_amount.description: Loan secured by a land charge, in euros (optional).

state.description: State (English or German name) or a covered city (e.g. "Bayern", "Munich").

name: purchase_costs_de
title: German purchase costs on a home, by state
